body: I saved the cloth with a sweet chemical smell for you. The water-treatment trial crew passed Thursday after closing; the rats left the shed, and afterward the clinic stopped answering.
title: Thursday after closing — a sweet chemical smell
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sweet chemical smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
A man sat by the back door and asked for the names of everyone who had come in. I assumed he meant the people still here.

He wanted the earlier customers too. I wrote down the one I knew because she brought her own mug. He crossed out her name, then asked whether I was certain she had arrived.

Her mug is still under the counter. I have not washed it, though I cannot say what that proves.
title: The visitor at closing
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
